logger.doc:name: Log Raw BlueDart Payload
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Normalizer] Processing BlueDart payload for AWB: ' ++ (payload.awb_no default payload.tracking_number default 'N/A') ++ ' | CorrelationId: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Canonical Event
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Normalizer] BlueDart normalized to Canonical Status: ' ++ (payload.normalizedStatus default 'N/A') ++ ' | EventKey: ' ++ (payload.eventKey default 'N/A')]

logger.doc:name: Log Raw Delhivery Payload
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Normalizer] Processing Delhivery payload for Waybill: ' ++ (payload.waybill default payload.tracking_number default 'N/A') ++ ' | CorrelationId: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Canonical Event
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- '[Normalizer] Delhivery normalized to Canonical Status: ' ++ (payload.normalizedStatus default 'N/A') ++ ' | EventKey: ' ++ (payload.eventKey default 'N/A')]

when.expression: #[(payload != null) and (!isEmpty(payload.awb_no default payload.awb default payload.tracking_number default '')) and (!isEmpty(payload.status_code default payload.status default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Log Malformed BlueDart Payload
logger.message: #['[Validation Failure] BlueDart payload missing required awb_no or status_code']

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Bad Request
raise-error.description: BlueDart payload is missing required tracking number (awb_no) or status_code.

when.expression: #[(payload != null) and (!isEmpty(payload.waybill default payload.waybill_no default payload.tracking_number default '')) and (!isEmpty(payload.Status.statusCode default payload.Status.status default payload.status default ''))]

logger.doc:name: Log Malformed Delhivery Payload
logger.message: #['[Validation Failure] Delhivery payload missing required waybill or Status']

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Bad Request
raise-error.description: Delhivery payload is missing required tracking number (waybill) or status.

raise-error.doc:name: Raise Unsupported Carrier Error
raise-error.description: #['Carrier ' ++ (vars.carrier default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' is not currently onboarded to the system. Supported: BLUEDART, DELHIVERY']
